title: Quick coverlet: owners dialsheet (May 2026)
summary: Compact cross-team owner map for ad-hoc coverage needs during the May 2026 burst window. Purpose: quickly identify who to call, expected fallback route, and single-line mitigations for P0/P1 surface issues.
body:
HEADER: Owner | Team | Primary contact (phone/email/Slack) | Current status | Risk level | Fallback route | Handoff ETA | Single-line mitigation notes

Rows:
1) Runtime: model routing | Serving Runtime | Tomas Rivera / t.rivera@redwood.ai / #serving-runtime | On-call + monitoring; small prewarm scheduled | P0 | Route to standby pool (dedicated-02) then hosted-slim | 2026-05-14 09:00 PT | Prewarm script (cron) + autoscale cap bump to 10% for 2 hrs; confirm burn budget with finance
2) Console: rollout pages | Console & Tooling | Jin Park / j.park@redwood.ai / #console | Canary running in us-west; small JS error spike | P1 | Rollback to 2026-05-12 stable build | 2026-05-13 11:00 PT | Temporary banner to users; disable new feature flag for 1 day
3) Observability: tracing and dashboards | Observability | Priya Deshmukh / p.deshmukh@redwood.ai / #observability | Dashboard alert noise high; retention job delayed | P1 | Use reduced retention query and aggregate view | 2026-05-13 08:30 PT | Run adhoc log-compact job; suppress low-value alerts for 6 hrs
4) Dedicated capacity: reserved pools | Dedicated | Miguel Santos / m.santos@redwood.ai / #dedicated | Capacity trending to 85% sustained | P0 | Move low-priority tenants to overflow-hosts | 2026-05-13 07:00 PT | Short-term tenant throttles + ticket owners notified; risk: billing spike
5) Private deployments: VPC syncs | Private Deployments | Elena Park / e.park@redwood.ai / #private-deploy | Several customers on patch window; intermittent API auth errors | P1 | Pause non-critical config syncs, escalate to infra | 2026-05-13 10:00 PT | Roll forward limited hotfix; prepare rollback checklist
6) Customer success: escalation queue | Customer Success | Noah Green / n.green@redwood.ai / #cs-escalations | Queue rising, 6 tickets >24h | P1 | Triage shift coverage + SE assist | 2026-05-13 09:00 PT | Send templated status to affected customers; offer dedicated office hour
7) Billing/Quotas: transient credit adjustments | Finance & Legal | Aisha Kapoor / a.kapoor@redwood.ai / #finops | Manual credits applied for surge cases | P2 | Use automation credits flow | 2026-05-14 12:00 PT | Confirm manual overrides reconciled in ledger

HEATMAP SUMMARY (one-liner per area):
- Serving Runtime: HOT — P0 (active mitigation running; watch dedicated pool burn)
- Console: WARM — P1 (canary error; rollback ready)
- Observability: WARM — P1 (alert noise affecting triage)
- Dedicated: HOT — P0 (capacity trending; short-term throttles planned)
- Private: WARM — P1 (customer-facing auth issues)
- CS: WARM — P1 (ticket backlog)
- Billing: COOL — P2 (manual credits temporary)

QUICK ACTIONS (owner -> action -> due):
- Tomas -> confirm standby pool routing applied & post screenshot -> 05-13 09:00 PT
- Jin -> revert canary and deploy patch (if needed) -> 05-13 11:00 PT
- Priya -> run log compaction + silence low-priority alerts -> 05-13 08:30 PT

- Noah -> triage top-3 customer tickets and send updates -> 05-13 09:15 PT

DECISIONS NEEDED (one-line):
- Approve temporary 10% dedicated burn (finance sign-off) — action: Aisha (due 05-13 16:00 PT)
- Accept brief console rollback (product approval) — action: Jin (due 05-13 10:00 PT)
